summary: T034.md is not directly executable as a single contract. The body carries a FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 marker plus a 2026-09-16 Owner amendment appended at the top: 'qualify ADR-010 routing, budget, and sampled A+B agreement as part of dataset completeness'. Owner Decision 5 (binding, recorded at /tmp/owner_decision_T034.txt) directs that this dual-layer expression be consolidated through the planning route (Planner -> Plan Reviewer) into a single unified contract body before any implementation begins. The amendment expands Decision 6 (five deterministic A+B required-sample rules with strict PoolId/partition bounds/EventKey/manifest-only selection, no RNG, no wall clock; complete=true requires all required samples to agree AND no other gap/error/budget failure; all-empty capability samples cannot substitute for result-bearing comparisons) and Decision 8 (infrastructure-correlation evidence state UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN with enum unknown_not_proven/known_correlated/evidenced_independent, reports may only use cross_endpoint_agreement, must not claim independent_provider_agreement, state must not be left blank and must be surfaced, UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN does not block ingestion/backtest but T034 must surface the limitation, correlated failure remains an explicit residual risk). The Developer is forbidden from picking only the old contract or only the amendment; the contract's Outcome/Deliverables/Acceptance/Must-not/References must be rewritten to absorb Decision 5/6/8 content and drop the FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE marker.

recommended_action: Route to planning via prepare-plan / finish-plan / prepare-plan-review / finish-plan-review for T034 only (other P03 tasks are out of scope here). The Planner must: (1) rewrite todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T034.md so that Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not, and References sections absorb the 2026-09-16 Owner amendment plus Decision 6 (five deterministic required-sample rules verbatim, with required-sample selection depending only on PoolId, partition bounds, EventKey, and manifest — no RNG, no wall clock; complete=true allowed only when all required samples agree AND no other gap/error/budget failure; all-empty capability samples may not substitute for result-bearing comparisons) and Decision 8 (enum unknown_not_proven/known_correlated/evidenced_independent with current state UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN, cross_endpoint_agreement-only phrasing, must-not-leave-blank rule, explicit residual-risk recording, and the non-blocking but must-surface rule for UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN); (2) add the preflight/actual call budget, endpoint capability snapshot, provider-to-interval provenance, response/storage volume, deterministic cross-provider sample selection with compared block hashes and logs, and known common operator/upstream infrastructure fields required by the amendment; (3) drop the FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 marker and the top-appended Owner-amendment block so the contract is a single unified body; (4) restate the implementation status unambiguously as T034 = data-quality and completeness reports with ADR-010 routing/budget/A+B agreement qualification. Must-not must forbid silently swallowing warning counts in aggregates and treating third-party matches as proof when raw chain evidence is incomplete. Then the independent Plan Reviewer verifies the merge is complete, consistent, and does not weaken any acceptance clause. Do not ask the Owner again whether the amendment is binding (already confirmed in /tmp/owner_decision_T034.txt) and do not change todo/config.yaml or the workflow controller.
